notes: 2026-09-16 (recognizer-lane pumpTarget-effect-structural propagation pass, DECLINED): real oracle text is "Until end of turn, target creature gets +1/+0 and gains ..." -- "until end of turn" is real here, but sits BEFORE "target creature gets", not trailing after the P/T numbers the way every other affected card in this pass has it. pumpTarget-effect-structural.ts's own regex only tolerates a TRAILING "until end of turn" (an optional non-greedy tail after the `gets \u00b1P/\u00b1T` capture); it has no support for a LEADING preamble. Setting `effect.untilEndOfTurn: true` on this card's own pumpTarget Effect without also widening the recognizer would make the regex require a trailing match that doesn't exist, causing the whole face to decline (0 matches) -- a real regression, not a safe field-only propagation. Declining the hand-patch-only route too: writing `untilEndOfTurn: true` directly onto the synergy.json Fact while leaving definition.ts's Effect object unset would create a real, confusing model/data mismatch with no recognizer behind it. Real, concrete follow-up (not attempted here): widen pumpTarget-effect-structural.ts's own pattern to also tolerate a leading "Until end of turn, target creature gets ..." order-variant, confirmed real via this card -- then this Effect's own untilEndOfTurn field and Fact can both be added together, safely.
